name: bookAppointment
description: Book the exact date and time the caller chose after checkAvailability confirms it is open. Before calling it, have their name, the address with ZIP code, what is going on, any access notes (gate code, pets, parking), and ask once for an email and whether it's OK to text them. If a conflict is returned, read the closest openings to the caller instead of asking them to guess. Only say the appointment is booked after this tool succeeds, using its sayToCaller sentence. Returns an internal reference that must never be read aloud.

callbackPhone.description: Only when the caller gives a DIFFERENT number to reach them on than the one they are calling from: that number, digits as spoken (e.g. 305-389-4611). Leave it out when they are happy with the number they called from.

callerEmail.description: The caller's email for the confirmation. Ask once right before booking; it is optional, so book without it if they decline or can't spell it.

serviceType.description: The service the caller wants, e.g. "Roof inspection" or "Furnace repair".

address.description: The job site address, when the business rules or the caller's request make it relevant.

notes.description: Everything else the team should see, one item per line. Start the line with "URGENT: " when the problem can't wait (e.g. water coming in now) and with "Access: " for how to get in (gate code, pets, parking). Per-industry intake answers go here as "Label: value" lines.

startTime.description: Appointment start, ISO 8601 date-time in the business's local time, e.g. 2026-09-30T14:00. Calculate it from the current date — never guess a past date.

endTime.description: Appointment end, ISO 8601 date-time in the business's local time, e.g. 2026-09-30T15:00. Default to one hour after startTime when the caller did not specify.

textOk.description: True if the caller said it's OK to text them about this appointment at this number, false if they said no. Leave it out if you didn't ask.

name: addBookingNote
description: Add a detail to the booking you just made on this call — a gate code, pets, parking, a second phone number, anything the caller mentions after bookAppointment succeeded. Call it once per detail, then tell the caller it's added. It only works after a successful bookAppointment on this call.

note.description: The detail as one short line, e.g. "Access: gate code 1010" or "Second phone: 305 555 0199 (husband)".

name: createLead
description: Capture a lead when the caller is not booking right now — they want a callback, a quote, or more information. Use when the agent cannot book an appointment but the caller's details should reach the team.

callbackPhone.description: Only when the caller gives a DIFFERENT number to reach them on than the one they are calling from: that number, digits as spoken (e.g. 305-389-4611). Leave it out when they are happy with the number they called from.

callerEmail.description: The caller's email, if they give one. Optional.

serviceRequested.description: What the caller needs, e.g. "New roof estimate".

address.description: The job site address, when relevant.

urgency.description: How quickly the caller needs help. Use "urgent" when the problem can't wait (for example water coming in right now).

notes.description: Any other details the team should see, written as ordinary sentences. Per-industry intake answers go here as "Label: value" lines, one per line.

callbackConsent.description: Set true only if the caller explicitly agreed the team may call them back.

name: checkAvailability
description: Check the real calendar before booking. When the caller names a day and time, send both preferredDate and preferredTime. The result says whether that exact time is open and gives the closest real openings if it is not. Never invent a time.

preferredDate.description: The day the caller prefers, as YYYY-MM-DD. Omit to search from today.

preferredTime.description: The caller's preferred local time, such as 8am, 08:00, 2:30 PM, morning, or afternoon. Omit only when they have no time preference.

serviceType.description: The service the caller wants, if it affects how long the visit takes.

durationMinutes.description: How long the appointment should be, in minutes. Omit to use the default of 60.

name: escalateCall
description: Hand an emergency to a person right now (the team is alerted by email). Use it ONLY when your instructions have an Escalation section that tells you to; otherwise book the soonest opening marked URGENT. Never promise a response time, and tell the caller to call emergency services first if anyone is in immediate danger.

reason.description: Why this is urgent, in one or two sentences.

summary.description: Any extra context the team needs to respond, such as what the caller reported.

name: lookupAppointment
description: Look up the caller's own upcoming appointments. Use when a caller wants to check, change, or cancel an existing booking. It verifies the caller by the number they are calling from, and tells you exactly which appointment numbers to pass to cancelAppointment.

callerName.description: The caller's name, if they gave it.

address.description: The job site address, if relevant.

name: cancelAppointment
description: Cancel one of the caller's verified appointments. ALWAYS call lookupAppointment first and ask the caller to confirm cancellation before calling this. Use confirmCancellation=true only after the caller explicitly says yes, and pass the appointmentNumber lookupAppointment told you to use.

confirmCancellation.description: Set true only after the caller has explicitly confirmed they want to cancel. Anything else will be refused.

appointmentNumber.description: The 1-based appointment number that lookupAppointment reported for the booking to cancel.

name: getCurrentDate
description: Get today's real date and day of week in the business's time zone. Use this before any date math — when a caller says "tomorrow" or "next Tuesday", compute the actual date from what this returns.
